name: Joey Mendoza Atkins

items.why: The item says no foreign-government, foreign-agent or foreign-parent ties were found, so it describes no conduct bearing on the foreign-ties criterion.

for_review: Item 1 is a null finding: no foreign-ties conduct was documented, and I did not search FARA or the other foreign-ties records myself. I searched the owner's named sites (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) together with his name, and nothing relevant came back. A search for lawsuits, Bar discipline or ethics complaints found nothing adverse, but the source was a third-party scorecard (CIVICS Scorecard). Check the Florida Bar and Florida Commission on Ethics records directly. Atkins lost the Nov. 3, 2026 general election to Wilton Simpson, about 51% to 49%, according to CBS12 and the AP. His occupation is trial attorney and former sports agent, and he held no elected office. I didn't weigh the real-work criterion because there was no item for it.
